using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions;

namespace Orleans.Transactions.AzureStorage
{
    public class AzureTableTransactionalStateOptionsValidator : IConfigurationValidator
    {
        private readonly AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions _options;
        private readonly string _name;

        public AzureTableTransactionalStateOptionsValidator(AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions options, string name)
        {
            _options = options;
            _name = name;
        }

        public void Validate()
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.TableName))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"TableName is required for {_name}");
            }

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(_options.ConnectionString))
            {
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"ConnectionString is required for {_name}");
            }
        }
    }
}

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Orleans.Transactions.AzureStorage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Tests
{
    public class AzureTableTransactionServicecollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage_ValidOptions_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Act and Assert
            services.AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage("test", options =>
            {
                options.TableName = "test-table";
                options.ConnectionString = "test-connection-string";
            });
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage_InvalidOptions_Throws()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            // Act and Assert
            Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() =>
            {
                services.AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage("test", options =>
                {
                    options.TableName = null;
                    options.ConnectionString = "test-connection-string";
                });
            });
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage_GetRequiredService_Called()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            services.AddOptions<AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions>("test");

            // Act
            services.AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage("test", options =>
            {
                options.TableName = "test-table";
                options.ConnectionString = "test-connection-string";
            });

            // Assert
            var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
            var optionsMonitor = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions>>();
            var options = optionsMonitor.Get("test");
            Assert.NotNull(options);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Orleans.Providers;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Orleans.Transactions.Abstractions;
using Orleans.Transactions.AzureStorage;

namespace Orleans.Hosting
{
    public static class AzureTableTransactionSiloBuilderExtensions
    {
        public static ISiloBuilder AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage(this ISiloBuilder siloBuilder, string name, Action<AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions> configureOptions = null)
        {
            configureOptions?.Invoke(new AzureTableTransactionalStateOptions());
            siloBuilder.Services.AddAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage(name, options =>
            {
                options.TableName = "test-table";
                options.ConnectionString = "test-connection-string";
            });
            return siloBuilder;
        }
    }
}
